steps.say: Three things need you before checkout can take cards.

input.title: Receipts
input.prompt:
You are the owner and long-term maintainer of this codebase, and its design is up to you.

Read the receipts spec.

input.title: Your shop bio
input.question:
Put the new line in the shop's profile.
Paste: Cards, wallets and bank transfer, all in one checkout.

input.title: Merge access
input.question: Press Squash merge on the checkout pull request.

input.title: New checkout
input.question: The new checkout is live on staging.
